name: torque-auto-parts-workspace
description: React JavaScript + FastAPI + MySQL, with an optional SQLite preview

scripts.install:all: npm install && node scripts/setup.mjs && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:open: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm run dev -w frontend -- --open"
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.db:check: cd backend && uv run python -m app.check_db
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
